name: Evi Hager
forbes_bio: Evi Hager is a major shareholder of the SE.
The company is a leading provider of solutions and services for electrical installations, covering business fields such as energy distribution, cable management, and building automation.
Hager SE generates consolidated group revenues exceeding $3.5 billion annually.
Originally founded as a GmbH, the company has a history spanning over three decades and transitioned into a Societas Europaea (SE) in May 2007.
The group operates internationally with a workforce exceeding 13,000 employees and manages well-known brands such as Hager, Berker, and E3/DC.

name: Fang Tonghua
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2016-2017); Hurun Global (2016-2025); Hurun China (2014-2025)
forbes_bio: Fang Tonghua chairs ZBD Pharmaceutical, a pharmaceuticals supplier.
Fang's ZBD listed at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in April 2015 after raising $240 million in an IPO.
ZBD's main products are Chinese medicines for cardiovascular disease.

name: Xiao Guoqing

forbes_bio: Xiao Guoqing is an executive director at China East Education, one of the largest providers of vocational training in China.
Xiao is the cousin of company chairman, Wu Wei.
Xiao Guoqing holds a degree in business administration from Renmin University in Beijing.

name: Feng Yuxia
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2023); Hurun Global (2021-2026); Hurun China (2012-2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2022-2025)
forbes_bio: Feng Yuxia chairs Joinn Laboratories (China), a China medical services provider.
Feng holds a master's degree in pharmacology from Academy of Military Medical Sciences and a MBA from Peking University.
Feng worked as a doctor at a military hospital from 1986 to 1989; she founded Joinn in 1995 in Beijing.

name: Lisa Draexlmaier
forbes_bio: Lisa and her father, Fritz Draexlmaier, preside over auto parts maker Fritz Draexlmaier Holding GmbH, of which Lisa is sole owner.
The $5.5 billion (2019 sales) company counts among its customers Audi, BMW, Cadillac, Land Rover, Maserati, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche and Tesla.
Subsidiaries around the world are named after the late Lisa Draexlmaier, Lisa´s grandmother, who cofounded the Draexlmaier group.
It got its start in 1958 with an order for 50,000 wiring harnesses for the Goggomobil, a microcar produced by Hans Glas GmbH.
It has diversified into the manufacture of electronic components, consoles, door and instrument panels and exclusive interiors for specific models.
forbes_facts: Although Fritz stepped down as CEO of the Draexlmaier manufacturing company in 2019, he still serves as chairman.
In 2017, Draexlmaier opened its first U.S. manufacturing site in Livermore, California, with 230 employees.

name: Wang Shuai

forbes_bio: Wang Shuai's fortune stems from his holding in Ant Group, a financial services affiliate of China's Alibaba Group.
China held up Ant's planned dual listing in Shanghai and Hong Kong on regulatory concerns on November 3, 2020.

name: Chen Xiao Ying

name: Jordan Katzman
forbes_bio: Jordan Katzman is a cofounder of SmileDirectClub, which sells custom teeth aligners online and at over 300 stores.
He started the company with friend Alex Fenkell in 2014; the two met at summer camp as teenagers, when they each had a mouth full of braces.
Katzman and Fenkell wanted to expand access to oral care after learning that 60% of counties in the U.S. don't have an orthodontist.
His dad, David Katzman, provided the initial funding for the company through his investment firm Camelot Venture Group and serves as CEO.
SmileDirectClub went public in September 2019 and made Katzman one of the nation's youngest billionaires.
